snippet.title: Jungle Rot (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Experience survival horror like it's 1999 in Jungle Rot! 
Pre-Rendered backgrounds, fixed camera angles and moaning zombies hungry for your flesh... 
Just like your childhood memories, only more rotten!

Play it now! 🧟‍♂️https://vexe.itch.io/jungle-rot 🧟‍♂️

EDIT: We've decided to expand the game to a fuller experience. Steam Demo is now up and available for wishlist. Thank you all for your support! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3779320/Jungle_Rot/
